dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave parabolic curve along the trailing edge, originating from a posterior notch and tapering smoothly toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification; contains a distinct high-luminance white pixel cluster at the terminal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear ascent at an angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the primary longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 1.2:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gentle convex arc with a large radius extending from the dorsal cranial midline to the rostrum junction.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stubby beak morphology with a pixel length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1:1.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 155 degrees where the melon contour meets the dorsal rostrum line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A singular, prominent white depigmentation patch or lesion located at the extreme apex of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-cyanide pixel hue across the entire somatic surface; secondary dorsal prominence visible on the posterior peduncle.
